Forthcoming Books in the New Horizons in Contemporary Writing Series

Cite as: Martin Paul Eve, "Forthcoming Books in the New Horizons in Contemporary Writing Series", eve.gd: Martin Paul Eve, May 21, 2018, https://doi.org/10.59348/y95wv-v0784.

I’m very pleased to be able to announce some forthcoming titles in the Bloomsbury New Horizons in Contemporary Writing series that I edit! Dates are, of course, subject to change but we have a really exciting line up of titles coming soon!

  • New Media and the Transformation of Postmodern American Literature by Casey Henry (2019)
  • David Mitchell’s Post-Secular World by Rose Harris-Birtill (2019)
  • Postcolonialism After World Literature by Lorna Burns (2019)
  • The Contemporary Post-Apocalyptic Novel by Diletta de Cristafaro (2019)
  • Jonathan Lethem and the Galaxy of Writing by Joe Brooker (2019)
  • Contemporary Posthumanism by Grace Halden (2021)
  • Northern Irish Writing After the Troubles by Caroline Magennis (2021)

If you’re interested in submitting a proposal, do get in touch.

Martin Paul Eve
Professor of Literature, Technology and Publishing
